value.rationale: The involution requirement is a natural, strictly stronger inverse matching question in finite semigroup theory. The theorem settles all ranks of the first eight chain transformation monoids, including non-divisibility-ratio classes, and proves sharp unavoidable idempotent displacement at n=5 and 7. It is a finite cutoff rather than a generic parity exercise.
